messages.text_excerpt:
Hi StartVirtual Bookkeeping Clients!

Thank you to everyone who joined our August Client Connect & Learn Meetup!

If you were unable to attend, here is a quick recap of the important

updates, reminders, and action items discussed during the session.

IMPORTANT TAX DEADLINES

Please mark your calendars for these upcoming extended filing deadlines:

📌 September 15, 2026

• Partnership tax returns

• S Corporation tax returns

📌October 15, 2026

• Individual tax returns

Please stay in regular communication with your bookkeeping team and submit

requested documents as early as possible to avoid delays.

PREPARE FOR THE 2026 YEAR-END CLOSE

To keep your books accurate and year-end ready, please begin organizing the

following documents:

• Property closing and settlement statements

• Property purchase documents

• Private money loan notes

• Wrap mortgage documentation

• Mortgage statements

• Bank statements

• Credit card statements

Submitting complete documentation allows our team to reconcile your

QuickBooks accounts accurately and prepare reliable financial reports.

PROPER ACCOUNTING FOR WRAP SALES

Our bookkeeping team recently completed additional training on recording

real estate wrap sales.

Unlike traditional property sales, where the full gain may be recognized at

the time of sale, wrap transactions require special accounting because the

seller continues to hold a note and generally receives payments over time.

Providing all related closing documents, loan agreements, and payment

records will help us record these transactions correctly.

2026 FORM 1099 UPDATE

Beginning with qualifying payments made in 2026, the federal Form 1099-MISC

and Form 1099-NEC reporting threshold generally increases from $600 to

$2,000.

Certain exceptions and entity-specific rules may apply, so please consult

your tax professional regarding your filing requirements.

To help us prepare accurate vendor reports:

• Confirm that vendors are properly categorized in QuickBooks.

• Collect updated Form W-9s from qualifying vendors.

• Respond to bookkeeping inquiries within 48 hours whenever possible.

• Review potential 1099 vendors before year-end.

We are also reviewing the available QuickBooks 1099 preparation options and

will share additional guidance during our next Client Connect meeting.

BANK & MORTGAGE ACCOUNT REMINDERS

• Some financial institutions integrate with QuickBooks more consistently

than others.

• Smaller banks, credit unions, and certain credit card providers may

experience frequent disconnections or import delays.

• If direct access to a mortgage account is unavailable, clients may submit

their mortgage statements quarterly.

• Our bookkeeping team will review the statements and adjust the related

loan liability at the end of each quarter.

NEW BUSINESS STRATEGY RESOURCES

StartVirtual Bookkeeping is transitioning its business strategy resources

to a new online community platform.

The community will feature:

• Business scaling insights from Cody Barton

• Monthly strategy sessions led by experienced mentors

• Additional resources to help clients strengthen and grow their businesses

More information about accessing the platform will be shared soon.

CLIENT ACTION ITEMS

☐︎ Submit outstanding bookkeeping documents.

☐︎ Begin organizing your 2026 year-end closing records.

☐︎ Provide mortgage statements at least quarterly if direct access is

unavailable.

☐︎ Send all bank and credit card statements needed for reconciliation.

☐︎ Collect updated Form W-9s from qualifying service providers.

☐︎ Respond to bookkeeping inquiries within 48 hours whenever possible.

Watch the Recap below

Click the button below to access the Client Connect session

🔗 August 2026 Client Connect & Learn Meetup RECAP

<https://drive.google.com/file/d/1yi66bmi2O9RHktjxH9awISMaPazE6ylo/view?usp=sharing>

Thank you for your continued trust in Start Virtual Bookkeeping. We

appreciate the opportunity to support your business and look forward to

helping you stay organized, compliant, and financially confident.

See you at our next Client Connect & Learn Meetup!

Thanks for being part of our community!

📩 Need help? Your bookkeeping team is just a message away.

or email Toni directly at toni@startvirtual.com.

Warm regards,

The StartVirtual Bookkeeping Team
